title: Scaffolding Permit
name: Scaffolding Permit
description: Permit for scaffold erection, alteration, use and dismantling, with design, competent erection, handover, inspection and access controls.

sections.title: DESIGN, FOUNDATIONS AND ERECTION
items: The scaffold configuration is either a recognised standard configuration or has a suitable design
Any required design drawings and calculations are current and available to the scaffold team
Ground, foundations, sole boards and base arrangements are suitable for the loads
Scaffolders and supervision are competent for the type and complexity of scaffold
Erection, alteration and dismantling methods control fall risk using collective protection where practicable
Ties, bracing and stability measures are installed to the required pattern
The scaffold will not rely on unverified parts of the permanent structure for stability
Interfaces with temporary works, excavations, hoists, loading bays and adjacent structures have been coordinated

fields.label: Fall Prevention Method During Erection / Alteration / Dismantling

sections.title: PLATFORMS, EDGE PROTECTION AND ACCESS
items: Working platforms are fully boarded or otherwise configured as designed
Top guardrails, intermediate protection and toe boards are provided where required
Openings, gaps and ladder access points are protected against falls
Safe ladder, stair or other access is provided and secured
Materials cannot fall from platforms onto people below
Loading bays and material gates are protected and used as designed
Unauthorised access, especially outside working hours, is controlled

sections.title: LOADING AND USE RESTRICTIONS
items: The intended working and material loads are within the scaffold design capacity
Loading restrictions are communicated and displayed where necessary
No sheeting, netting, hoist, chute, loading bay or other significant load has been added unless allowed by design
Scaffold will not be altered by unauthorised persons
Users know to stop using the scaffold if damage, movement or missing components are found

fields.label: Sheeting / Netting / Hoists / Chutes / Other Attachments

sections.title: HANDOVER AND INSPECTION
items: The scaffold has been inspected by a competent person following installation / before first use
A handover or inspection record identifies the scaffold and any restrictions
Construction scaffolds requiring statutory inspection are scheduled at intervals not exceeding 7 days
The scaffold will be re-inspected after alteration, high winds, impact or other events that could affect safety
Inspection records identify defects and corrective actions
The scaffold will be taken out of use if an inspection identifies an unsafe condition

sections.title: AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: The permit holder understands the scaffold status, load limits and restrictions
Any alteration will be undertaken only by authorised competent scaffolders
During dismantling, exclusion and falling-object controls will remain in place
Following dismantling, ties, anchors, openings and affected surfaces will be made safe
The work area is safe for hand-back
